description: An eight-step sequencer, each step with a voltage knob, a gate button and a probability knob

params.text: Sets the voltage that step sends, from 0V to the ceiling set by the RANGE knob
Turns the gate for that step on or off
Sets every voltage knob at random
Sets the root note the pitch output is quantised to
Sets the scale the pitch output is quantised to; the last setting leaves the pitch alone
Turns the gates on and off at random
Sets the highest voltage a step knob can reach, 0V to 10V, which is how wide the pitch spread is
Shifts the pitch output by whole octaves, -5 to +7
How likely that step's gate is to fire, from never at the bottom of its travel to every time at the top
Sets every probability knob at random
Up, the probability knobs govern whether a gate fires; down, they are left out of that and the PROB output carries them as plain voltage
Sets how many of the eight steps play before the sequence starts over

inputs.text: A trigger here sends the sequence back to its first step
Each trigger here advances the sequence by one step
A trigger here sets every voltage knob at random
A trigger here turns the gates on and off at random
Added to the RANGE knob, volt for volt
Added to the ROOT knob, 0V to 10V covering the twelve notes
Added to the SCALE knob, 0V to 10V covering every scale
Added to the OCTAVE knob, a volt per octave
A trigger here sets every probability knob at random
Added to the LENGTH knob, 0V to 10V covering the eight steps

outputs.text: The gate for the step now playing
The pitch for the step now playing, quantised to the root and scale
A trigger at the end of each pass through the sequence
The probability knob of the step now playing, as a voltage

menu: Gate Mode — sets what the gate output does: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Ignore Gate for V/OCT Out — keeps the pitch output following the sequence even on steps whose gate is off
Traversal Pattern — sets the order the eight steps are played in, reading them as two rows of four: Row-Major, Col-Major, Snake Rows, Snake Cols
Gate Length — sets how long a Trigger or Retrigger gate lasts, in milliseconds
